verdict.rationale: GitLab has strong CI/CD capabilities (build/test automation, API access, CLI) documented, and its API (gitlab-docs-10) and CLI (gitlab-probe-3) support headless/scripted automation, with GitLab CI itself being a headless automation engine referenced via gitlab-docs-8. However, evidence lacks explicit documentation of running GitLab Duo/agent features headlessly in CI pipelines, and community reports note reliability issues with CI workers not running (gitlab-comm-1), which tempers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit docs on invoking AI/agent features headlessly within CI jobs, and independent corroboration that headless CI automation works reliably at scale.
